propositions: Add a [code_health] configuration section dataclass to _config_schema.py with typed fields for enabled, scan_roots, analyzers, size_cap, and size_near_fraction.
Configuration overrides via rebar -c code_health.<key>=<val> must parse correctly through existing path infrastructure.
The code_health section must be re-exported through config.py and accessible to clients for declaring scan roots and per-language tool selection.
Default values must be documented and applied when the [code_health] section is absent from configuration.
Golden configuration surface schema snapshot at tests/golden/config_surface.json must be regenerated to reflect the new section.
Unit tests must verify default load behavior, command-line override parsing, and missing-section fallback.
